main.description: Write bytes to the stdin of an active SSH session.

sessionId.description: Session ID returned by the subscribe endpoint.

data.description: Base64-encoded bytes to write to the SSH session's stdin.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Caller not permitted by RBAC policy.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Malformed body or missing required fields.

errors.name: SessionNotFound
errors.description: No active SSH session with the given ID.

errors.name: SessionClosed
errors.description: The SSH session has already exited.
